response.sql:
WITH per_rating AS (
  SELECT rating,
         AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_rental_duration,
         AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_rate_to_replacement_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
), summary AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rental_duration) AS avg_per_rating_duration,
         AVG(avg_rate_to_replacement_ratio) AS avg_per_rating_ratio
  FROM per_rating
)
SELECT rating, avg_rental_duration, avg_rate_to_replacement_ratio
FROM per_rating
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ALL RATINGS', avg_per_rating_duration, avg_per_rating_ratio
FROM summary;

assumptions.assumption: “Pricier-to-replace” means replacement_cost strictly greater than 20.99; the final row averages the per-rating averages equally across ratings. NULL inputs are excluded by AVG.
